thread:
leo (Design): small copy PR to review: the confirmation dialog when deleting an eval suite reads `Delete eval?` with buttons `Cancel` and `Delete`. feedback: feels terse and possibly unclear about scope (are results, prompts, and historic runs deleted?). screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/delete-eval.png :thought_balloon:

anya (Product): agreed. users have accidentally deleted suites before. need to be explicit about what will be removed and if it's reversible.

jordan (Eng): backend: deleting an eval suite purges associated runs and prompts but we keep a tombstone for 90 days for recovery. action is irreversible from UI until that window.

leo (Design): proposed microcopy options (aim for clarity + shortness):
- "Delete eval suite and all runs? This action can be reversed within 90 days.
  [Cancel] [Delete suite]"
- "Delete suite — removes saved prompts and run history. Recoverable for 90 days.
  [Cancel] [Delete permanently]"
- "Are you sure you want to delete the 'NLP test' eval suite? This will remove prompts and results (recoverable for 90 days).
  [Cancel] [Delete]"
Which feels best? trying to keep primary button label explicit and avoid scary phrasing like `permanently` when there is a recovery window.

marta (QA): prefer the middle option but change `Delete permanently` to `Delete now` to avoid conflict with recovery. tests: verify toast and activity feed entries after deletion, and that recover-from-tombstone flow works.

anya (Product): i like the first one but shorten: `Delete eval suite and runs. Recoverable for 90 days. [Cancel] [Delete suite]` Primary CTA `Delete suite` is clear. also add a small inline link `Learn more` to docs about recovery.

jordan (Eng): note on accessibility: dialog should include explicit listing of affected items (checkbox list) for large suites, and keyboard focus must move into dialog. screen reader text should read the full sentence including the 90-day recovery.

leo (Design): updated compact copy for UI: `Delete eval suite and runs. Recoverable for 90 days.` button labels: `Cancel` and `Delete suite` (primary). aria-describedby includes longer explanation with recovery steps and link to docs. i'll update PR with copy + a11y checklist.

ci-bot: branch "eval-delete-copy" created -> PR #901

leo (Design): thanks all — will add test notes and a screenshot to the PR. :white_check_mark:
